channel.description: Latest articles from Reno News & Review (renonr.com)

item.title: Art Notes: The high school poetry champ is from Yerington; it’s time for artists to get on the Artown schedule; and more!
item.description: Meet the Yerington student who will represent the state at the Poetry Out Loud national finals; details on the Desert Heart Film Society’s next screening; last call to be on the Artown calend…

item.title: The Foilies 2026: Recognizing the worst in government transparency
item.description: We give out The Foilies, tongue-in-cheek “awards” during Sunshine Week (March 15-21), a collective effort by media and advocacy organizations to highlight the importance of open government.

item.title: The Dish: Monika Marsh, owner, Edelweiss Pizza Pub and Pastries
item.description: Edelweiss came about almost by accident. Monika Marsh’s husband found a space for lease, and she knew immediately what she wanted to do with it: Serve the food she grew up eating.

item.title: Pod(cast) people: Our reviewer found the premise of ‘Undertone’ to be ridiculous and annoying—but his fellow audience members disagreed
item.description: With Undertone, we are getting a new kind of horror, the second cousin of found-footage horror films … the podcast-must-go-on horror movie.

item.title: Farewell to ‘The Reno Gay Page’: After 33 years of publishing the main source of LGBTQ news in Reno, Paco LaChoy is moving on

item.title: Music Notes: The Electric’s bassist returns to the stage after illness; a punk song about trains; and more!
item.description: After a serious illness, The Electric bassist Darin Goslar is returning to the stage with his bandmates next week at Cargo Concert Hall.

item.description: “Right now, only about 28% of students in fourth grade are reading at grade level statewide. Washoe County—we’re a little bit higher. We’re about 42%,” said literacy advocat…

item.title: Locked and loaded: Jackyl brings their head-banging yet blues-y songs to Cargo Concert Hall
item.description: Jackyl are slated to perform on Tuesday, March 24 at the Cargo Concert Hall in Reno. It’ll be yet another date for the band whose Instagram bio proudly claims “ALWAYS ON TOUR!”
